tools.name: estimate_vram
tools.description: GPU memory, number of GPUs, speed and rental cost to run an open LLM. Works for the models listed at https://studiotvai.com/api/models.json and any Hugging Face model id or link. Uses the real KV cache of each architecture (sliding window, hybrid linear attention, MLA).

model.description: Model name or id ("Llama 3.3 70B", "qwen3.8-27b"), Hugging Face id ("Qwen/Qwen3-32B") or link.

gpu.description: GPU id or name, e.g. "rtx-4090", "H100", "mac-m4-max-128". Default h100. List: https://studiotvai.com/api/gpus.json

gpu_count.description: Number of GPUs, or "auto" (default) for the fewest that fit.

concurrent_requests.description: Requests served at the same time, each with its own KV cache. Default 1.

weights.description: Weight format. Default: the official checkpoint (native) or BF16.

kv_cache.description: KV cache precision. Default bf16. nvfp4: vLLM only, NVIDIA GPUs, models with standard attention (otherwise bf16 is used).

engine.description: Serving engine. Default: vllm on data-center GPUs, llamacpp elsewhere.

system_ram_gb.description: System RAM in GB of a personal machine (gaming GPU with llama.cpp). When the model does not fit in GPU memory, estimate_vram then says whether it runs with part of it in RAM, and how fast. Omit if unknown.

tools.name: models_that_fit
tools.description: Every listed open model that fits on the given GPU(s), largest first, with the most faithful weight format that fits.

concurrent_requests.description: Requests served at the same time, each with its own KV cache. Default 1.

weights.description: Weight format. Default: the official checkpoint (native) or BF16.

kv_cache.description: KV cache precision. Default bf16. nvfp4: vLLM only, NVIDIA GPUs, models with standard attention (otherwise bf16 is used).

engine.description: Serving engine. Default: vllm on data-center GPUs, llamacpp elsewhere.

system_ram_gb.description: System RAM in GB of a personal machine (gaming GPU with llama.cpp). When the model does not fit in GPU memory, estimate_vram then says whether it runs with part of it in RAM, and how fast. Omit if unknown.

tools.name: gpu_prices
tools.description: Cheapest on-demand price per GPU-hour from AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, RunPod, Vast.ai, Oracle Cloud, OVHcloud, Scaleway, Verda, Akash and UpCloud, checked every hour.

gpu.description: GPU id or name. Omit for every GPU.
